markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 一句话里有两个动词时，它们的时态要**互相配合**。记两条：前面说了 said、thought 这类过去，后面跟着**往后退一步**；when、if 后面说将来，**不用 will**。

uses.zh: 前面是过去，后面跟着退
前面是过去，后面跟着退
uses.en_zh: 我还以为你在伦敦工作。

uses.zh: when 后面说将来，用现在时

backshift.title: 往后退一步
backshift.text: 像搬家一样，每个时态往「过去」那边挪一格。你说话的时候，那件事已经是过去听到的了，所以跟着变旧。

rules.ending: 现在完成时 / 一般过去时

examples.en: I <<didn't know>> you [[had left]] the company.
examples.zh: 我不知道你已经离职了。
examples.rule: 原来的事：You left the company.

examples.en: She <<told>> me she [[would]] send it on Friday.
examples.zh: 她跟我说她周五会发过来。
examples.rule: 原话：I will send it on Friday.

noshift.title: 什么时候不用退
noshift.text: 两种情况可以不退：前面那个动词本身是**现在时**；或者说的事**到现在还是真的**。

items.rule: 前面是现在时（says、think、know），后面照原样
永远都对的事，可以不退
items.en: Our teacher <<said>> the Earth [[goes]] round the Sun.
items.zh: 老师说地球绕着太阳转。

items.rule: 到现在还是这样，可以不退（退也不算错）

noshift.tip: 前面是过去时（said、told）又拿不准的时候，就退，退了基本不会错。

timeclause.title: when 后面说将来
timeclause.text: when、as soon as、before、after、until、if 后面说将来的事，**用一般现在时，不用 will**。will 只放在另一半里。
formula: 主句用 will / 祈使句

examples.en: <<As soon as>> the review [[is]] done, I'll merge it.
<<If>> it [[rains]] at the weekend, we'll stay in.
examples.zh: 要是周末下雨，我们就待在家里。

wrong.bad: When I ~~will get~~ home, I'll call you.

finished.title: 做完了再做
finished.text: 想强调「先把这件事**做完**，再做下一件」，when、after 后面用 **have done**。还是不用 will。

examples.en: <<When>> I[['ve finished]] this ticket, I'll help you.
examples.zh: 等我做完这个工单就来帮你。

examples.en: You can go home <<after>> you[['ve sent]] the report.
examples.zh: 报告发出去以后你就可以回家了。

examples.en: <<As soon as>> they[['ve fixed]] the bug, we'll release.
examples.zh: 他们一修好这个 bug，我们就发版。

commonMistakes.why: 前面是 said，后面跟着退一步。

commonMistakes.bad: I'll text you when I ~~will arrive~~.
commonMistakes.why: when 后面说将来，用现在时。
have done 退一步变成 had done。

quiz.prompt: I'll call you when I ___ home.
quiz.explain: <<when>> 后面说将来用现在时：I [[get]] home。
前面是 said，is 退一步变成 [[was]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成转述：Leo said, "I can fix it."
quiz.answer: Leo said he could fix it.
accept: Leo said that he could fix it.

traps.input: Leo said he can fix it.
traps.note: 前面是 said，can 要退成 could。

quiz.prompt: I didn't know you ___ (leave) the company.
quiz.explain: 离职发生在「不知道」之前，退成 [[had left]]。

quiz.prompt: Tom told me he ___ send the file the next day, but he never did.
He says he ___ busy right now.
quiz.explain: 前面是 <<says>>（现在时），后面不用退：[[is]]。

quiz.prompt: Our teacher said water ___ at 100 degrees.
quiz.explain: 永远都对的事可以不退：[[boils]]。

quiz.prompt: As soon as the review ___ (be) done, I'll merge it.

traps.note: as soon as 后面说将来，不用 will。

quiz.explain: <<As soon as>> 后面用现在时：[[is]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Don't leave until Sam will arrive.
If it ___ (rain) at the weekend, we'll stay in.
When I ___ (finish) this ticket, I'll help you.
quiz.explain: 强调先做完，用 [[have finished]]；用 finish 也对。

quiz.prompt: You can go home after you ___ the report.
quiz.explain: 先做完再走，用 [[have sent]]，不用 will。

quiz.prompt: ___ will the new version be ready?
quiz.explain: 这是问「什么时候？」，问句里的 [[When]] 可以跟 will。

quiz.prompt: 改错：She said she is busy yesterday.
quiz.answer: She said she was busy yesterday.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我一到办公室就给你发消息。
quiz.answer: I'll text you as soon as I get to the office.
accept: I will text you as soon as I get to the office.
I'll message you as soon as I get to the office.
I will message you as soon as I get to the office.
As soon as I get to the office, I'll text you.
As soon as I get to the office, I'll message you.
I'll text you as soon as I arrive at the office.
I'll message you as soon as I arrive at the office.

traps.input: I'll text you as soon as I will get to the office.
traps.note: as soon as 后面不用 will。

quiz.explain: <<as soon as>> 后面用现在时：I [[get]] to the office。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我还以为你在伦敦工作。
quiz.answer: I thought you worked in London.
accept: I thought that you worked in London.

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话：转述一位同事昨天说过的一句话；再用 when 或 as soon as 说一件你接下来要做的事；最后用 after … have done 说一个先后安排。
rules: said / told / thought 后面的时态往过去退一步
when / as soon as / after / until / if 说将来时不用 will
openTask.note: 规则判时态后退和时间从句里有没有 will（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
